summary: New Mountain Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a routine monthly cash distribution of $0.19 per common share, declared September 28, 2026 by the Board of Trustees, payable September 30 to holders of record and paid on or about October 30, 2026 in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. The filing also reports August 31, 2026 NAV per share of $22.84, aggregate NAV of roughly $949.4 million, portfolio fair value of about $1,881.1 million, and $938.6 million of debt principal. No special-situation event is present; watch monthly NAV trends and continuous private offering pace.
